fields.valence3: None if valence is None else ('Negative' if valence <= 2 else ('Neutral' if valence == 3 else 'Positive'))
fields.direction: None if E1 is None else ('Upwards' if BR > E1 else ('Downwards' if BR < E1 else None))
fields.update: None if (E1 is None or E2 is None or direction is None) else abs(E2 - E1) * (-1 if ((direction == 'Downwards' and E2 - E1 > 0) or (direction == 'Upwards' and E2 - E1 < 0)) else 1)

trials.note: one row per event per participant (the trial of the update method); trials with E1 == BR get direction None and drop out of every effect (paper p. 7; main-lmms.R 'Remove trials where E1 = BR'); trials outside cell mean +/- 3 IQR of update (valence x direction, per study) are trimmed (p. 7)

answers.e2.est: round(answer('e1.est', ev=ev) + (data['br'][ev] - answer('e1.est', ev=ev)) * ((0.2 if int(ev) % 3 != 2 else (0.3 if arm == 's1' else (0.6 if arm == 's3' else 0.4))) if data['br'][ev] > answer('e1.est', ev=ev) else (0.6 if int(ev) % 3 != 2 else (0.5 if arm == 's1' else (0.2 if arm == 's3' else 0.4)))))
